# GSAP

GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.15.0 were obtained from the official `gsap` npm package on 2026-09-24. Copyright notices are retained in the distributed JavaScript files.

The package declares: Standard 'no charge' license: https://gsap.com/standard-license.

Official license: https://gsap.com/community/standard-license/
Official installation documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Installation/

GSAP uses its own license; it is not represented here as MIT-licensed or open-source. The existing user-supplied animation used GSAP 3.12.5; this adaptation uses the current package and compatible APIs.
